{{Quote|An infantry battalion is stationed here, the Eighty-ninth—five companies of Pop-Dogs.|Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK" />}}
The '''Chakham Army Base''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] military base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] named after [[General/Legends|General]] [[Chakham]] of the [[New Republic]]. It was built around the time [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] assumed command of the [[Galactic Alliance Army]], and its groundbreaking ceremony was attended by many of the original [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite Galactic Alliance army unit founded and led by Thaal. The base served as a test site for new weapons systems being evaluated for possible deployment. The Pop-Dogs stationed there also operated a small unit of E-wing starfighters, which were theoretically intended for training.<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the [[Eighty-ninth]], five companies of Pop-Dogs army unit, was stationed on the base.<ref name="MK" />
